subject.operating_margin.definition: Operating income / selected total revenue; annual fraction.

subject.revenue_growth.definition: Selected annual total revenue / prior annual total revenue - 1; fraction.

subject.return_on_average_equity.definition: Annual net income / average beginning and ending stockholders' equity; fraction.

subject.debt_to_equity.definition: Noncurrent long-term debt plus current portion / ending stockholders' equity; excludes other short-term borrowings and leases.

subject.free_cash_flow.definition: Operating cash flow minus cash additions to property and equipment; desk definition, may differ from issuer's adjusted measure.

subject.pe.definition: Supplied market price / latest annual diluted EPS; annual, not forward or trailing-quarter EPS.
